item.name: CreateMerchant
item.description:
# Create Merchant API

This API is used to create a new merchant account on the PayU platform by submitting all required KYC details.

## Authentication

The API requires a Bearer token for authorization. This token must be generated using the Client ID and Client Secret via the Get Token API.
Scope for token generation: 'refer merchant'.

## Important Notes

1. Fields like mobile, PAN, and GSTIN undergo real-time validation during the request processing.
2. Types like business_entity_type, business_category, and business_sub_category accept specific pre-defined values.
3. The response will include a unique Merchant ID (MID) and UUID which are critical for making updates or fetching merchant details later.
